ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 35% high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and medial sections are characterized by contiguous low-intensity dark pigmentation. Lateral wings exhibit high-intensity white background mapping heavily populated with high-frequency, small-diameter low-intensity mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated pixel angle of 45 degrees; depth is significant, extending approximately 15% into the vertical height of the fluke assembly.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with varying pixel-amplitudes (5-20 pixels) and high-frequency serrations concentrated on the outer distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges tapering into sharp distal tips; trailing edges show a generally straight to slightly concave curvature from the notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of roughly circular pixel anomalies (barnacle colonization) are visible on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct, dark vertical linear mark is visible on the lower-left high-intensity region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization at distal tips; multiple fine dark linear streaks and punctures visible across the light-pigmented regions of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Characteristic high-density 'salt and pepper' mottling pattern extensively distributed across the white ventral surfaces of both lobes.
